disposition_reason: Five pepper-type samples bought along the Papa-Abeokuta highway analysed for six metals by AAS; one mean per sample type.

study.market: five points of sale along Papa-Abeokuta highway, Ogun State, Nigeria
study.method: wet digestion (H2O2, H2SO4, HNO3, perchloric acid) and flame AAS (Perkin Elmer 900) after washing, oven-drying at 60 C and grinding
study.qa: reagent blank and calibration standards only; no CRM or recovery
